text.en: 1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 6) Notification 2018 and is deemed to have come into operation on 4 January 2017.

2.—(1) The interest payable by Grand Blue Shipping Pte Ltd —
(a)to the lenders mentioned in the first column of the following table;
(b)in respect of the respective loan amounts mentioned in the second column of the table used to finance the construction of the ship “Sunny Putney”;
(c)under the respective novation agreements mentioned in the third column of the table; and
(d)that is due and payable during the respective periods mentioned in the fourth column of the table,
is exempt from tax:
